title: 300 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Canggu Bali
metaTitle: 300 Hours Yoga Teacher Training in Canggu Bali
metaDescription: 300 hours yoga teacher training in Canggu Bali. Bali Yoga School invites all yoga enthusiasts to Bali to experience the best of yoga and travel in Canggu – the next emerging hotspot of Bali after Ubud, for yogi travelers from all over the world.
summary: After completing 300 Hour yoga teacher training, you will be able to teach beginner, intermediate and advanced level yoga students with confidence.
intro: After completing 300 Hour yoga teacher training, you will be able to teach the beginner, intermediate and advanced level yoga students with confidence. We train yoga teachers to become independent, wise and flexible and you will be prepared to deal with the most challenging class, special needs and health issues of the clients.

Course includes advanced practices of yoga, advanced asanas, advanced pranayama, advanced yoga philosophy, advanced yoga anatomy & physiology, yoga therapy and other subjects. During the course, the asana practices are physically challenging but the course has been designed with an intellectual perspective to balance it with meditation & pranayama practices.
Bali Yoga School offers excursions, ayurvedic cooking classes, kirtan nights and Satsang sessions in addition to the course on 300 hours yoga teacher training in Canggu Bali.

curriculum.title: Mastering Ashtanga Primary Series & intermediate series postures

On 3rd week – Intermediate series postures/ Mysore Style /Teaching methods.
On 4th week – Teaching by students / Questions & Answers / Feedback by teacher on improvements.

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. By following a plant-based diet during your training, you are in the practice of ahimsa.
mealTimes: Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 10:00 am with the opening ceremony & orientation program. In order to attend the opening ceremony of the course you should arrive at school a day before the starting date of the course. The course completes on 28th of every month at 7:00 pm with graduation & fire ceremony performed by the graduates & their masters. Departure date is 28th of every month before 12:00 pm.

Our 300-hour Yoga Teacher Training in Canggu, Bali begins on the 1st of every month at 5:00 PM with an opening ceremony and orientation. The course concludes on the 6th of every month. To ensure you are well-rested before the training begins, we recommend arriving one day earlier. Check-in is available between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM, and we offer a complimentary night's stay before the course starts. On the final day, check-out should be completed between 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM.

The closest and most convenient airport is Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS), Denpasar, located approximately 20 km from our Canggu campus. Once you have booked your flight, simply share your arrival details with us, and we will arrange an airport pickup.

Complimentary pickup from DPS (I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport) is included in your course fee. Please send us your flight information after booking so we can organize your transfer smoothly.
prerequisites: All students joining our 300-hour Yoga Teacher Training are required to complete the prerequisite assignment before arrival and submit it during check-in. Please print the assignment and compile it into a file for submission. This process ensures that all participants begin the training with a strong foundation for a meaningful and enriching learning experience.

Upon confirmation of your 300-hour YTT booking, we will provide the assignment questions along with our 200-hour YTT course manual. If you are unable to complete the assignment due to limited time before the course starts, you may submit it within the first 7 days of the training.
Students are also recommended to start incorporating yoga practices in their day-to-day life before the course.
A high degree of self-motivation is required for all aspects of the course. The practice and especially the teaching of yoga demand a high degree of self-discipline and purity.

policies.title: Dress code for opening and graduation ceremony
items: Keep 1 or 2 pairs of white clothes for the opening and graduation ceremony of the course.

policies.title: Class Attendance
items: All classes are mandatory; only in case of an emergency or illness one can take leave with the respective teacher's permission. Uninformed leaves won't be accepted and this will leave a bad impression on the student's monthly performance.

policies.title: Course Rules
items: Participants are required to attend all spiritual activities, meditation sessions, lectures and asana classes.
Meat, fish, eggs, black tea, coffee, alcohol, tobacco, drugs and nudity are prohibited during the course as they are counterproductive to the yoga practice.
Participants who do not comply with the school rules may be dismissed from the course.

policies.title: Discipline Rules for Students
items: Smoking and alcohol are strictly prohibited in the school.
If you are having a fast any day, you have to inform the kitchen manager to avoid food waste.
Always maintain discipline, respect teachers and follow all rules. Always be on time; if you are late you will not be permitted to join class.
Clear your books of account before departure from Himalayan Yoga Association. Before departure return your books, maps or any goods which you borrowed.

Himalayan Yoga Association provides accommodation for a student who joins the yoga course. Friends or relatives will not be included in accommodation; however they can stay in school by renting another room.
Students have to be present in all scheduled programs of Himalayan Yoga Association.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: The course fees & booking amount will not be refundable; only in the case of emergency students can join us on other schedules.
If a student cancels the course after joining it, we accept cancellation but course fees will not be refunded.
